scenarios.name: station-puts-charge-counters-equal-to-tapped-creatures-power
scenarios.why: Station is an activated ability that uses the stack (CR 702.184a: "Tap another untapped creature you control: Put a number of charge counters on this permanent equal to the tapped creature's power. Activate only as a sorcery."). The engine offers it under its own option kind ("station"), selected through the activate op; the tap is the cost. Once the ability resolves, tapping a 2/2 has put two charge counters on the Spacecraft, and the tapped creature is tapped.

scenarios.name: station-waits-on-the-stack
scenarios.why: Station is an activated ability, not a special action: after the cost (the tap) is paid, the ability sits on the stack and no charge counters have been placed until it resolves.

scenarios.name: station-offered-with-another-creature
scenarios.why: Station is an activated ability that taps another creature; with an untapped creature available it is offered as a sorcery during turn 1's first main phase.

scenarios.name: station-not-offered-without-another-creature
scenarios.why: Station requires tapping ANOTHER creature; the Spacecraft alone (not a creature below 8 charge counters) has no legal tap candidate, so it is not offered.
